messages.subject: Reset Input Variables
parts:
I am hoping this is a simple issue.  I have an App that allows the user to chose a CSV and then chose the plotting variables based on that file's column names.  All works just fine until the user choses another file that has different column names from the previous file.  Basically it appears that the file opens, the data is read in and it immediately goes to the plot using the previously chosen columns which throws an error that the columns do not exist.  How do I force the variables connected to the selectInput control to update before any other code executes?

Thanks for any suggestions.

Here is a simplified version of my code:


library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  
   titlePanel("File Input Test"),
  
   fileInput("fname","Input File",width='100%'),
   textOutput("filename"),
   fluidRow(
     column(width=12,
            wellPanel(
              fluidRow(
                column(width=4,selectInput("x","x Col",choice=NA, selected=NULL,width='200px')),
                column(width=4,selectInput("y","y Col",choice=NA, selected=NULL,width='200px'))
               
               
              )
            )
     )
   ),
   ggvisOutput("Plot")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
 
  indata<-reactive({
   
   req(input$fname$datapath)
   read.csv(input$fname$datapath,header=TRUE)
  })
 
  observe({

    updateSelectInput(session,"x",choices=c("NA",sort(colnames(indata())),selected = "NA"))
    updateSelectInput(session,"y",choices=c("NA",sort(colnames(indata())),selected = "NA"))
  
  
 
    })
 
 
  observe({
    if(input$x!="NA" & input$y!="NA")
    {
      data<-indata()[,c(input$x,input$y)]
      colnames(data)<-c('x','y')
      data %>% ggvis(~x, ~y) %>%
      bind_shiny("Plot")
    }
  })
  
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
